spans.s:
The form इच्छा 'desire' is irregular.

Terms: Irregular

The affixes लिङ् (Benedictive) and लोट् (Imperative) are used after a root when another verb having the same sense of 'wishing' is in construction with it.

Terms: लिङ् and लोट्

After roots meaning 'to wish' the लिङ् (Benedictive) is optionally used denoting the present time.

Terms: लिङ्
